summary: National Park Service fire lookout on Mitchell Peak, Kings Canyon NP, built 1962; tower pulled down in the 1970s per a 2006 column; a concrete slab dated 1962 remains on the summit.

facts.design: Appears to be an R-6 Flat Top plan on a 10-foot steel K-Brace open tower
facts.status_note: Tower gone; the register gives removal date as unknown, and a 2006 column says it was pulled down in the 1970s. A concrete slab dated 1962 remains

access.note: Peak is in Kings Canyon National Park; a 2006 column describes a stiff 3.2-mile hike to the top. No closure is described in the sources read, and the newest account is from 2006

visit.trail_note: A 2006 column describes a stiff 3.2-mile hike to the top; the trailhead and route are not given

events.note: Register: constructed 1962 as an R-6 Flat Top plan on a 10-foot steel K-Brace open tower (appears to be). Photos credited to the NPS show construction in 1962
Decade only: the 2006 column says the tower was pulled down in the 1970s. The exact year is not known; the register gives removal date as unknown

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the removal date as unknown; the 2006 column says the tower was pulled down in the 1970s. The record keeps the register's unknown date and the story gives the column's decade.
Register gives 10,369 ft (3,160 m); the 2006 column says 10,365-foot. The record keeps the register's 3,160.5 m.

sources.title: Visitors to California's renovated fire towers find simple solitude
sources.publisher: FireRescue1 (republished Los Angeles Times column by Susan Spano, September 18, 2006)

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The California Lookouts (Forest Lookouts) page has a Mitchell Peak heading with no text. The removal decade and today's condition rest on a single 2006 column; no source after 2006 describes the site, so treat the 'today' section as dated. The column (by Susan Spano, Los Angeles Times, September 18, 2006) is republished on FireRescue1. The register's build year and the 1962 slab are both from the register. Photos: the register credits NPS photos (Under construction 1962) and a peakbagging.com photo of the remaining slab, but no image URLs were captured. A public-domain NPS image (NPGallery asset fc21e68b-ae14-4c1d-8d80-2f1fa195cb1f, 'Construction, Mitchell Peak Lookout', credit Scottie Steenburgh per the asset comment) is a candidate once its direct image URL is confirmed; no photo added. Search calls used: 2. Page reads: 4 (FFLOS, Forest Lookouts, FireRescue1, NPGallery asset page).
